Honest gate (26 Nov 23:00 UTC): YES for spreadsheets + wedding in ENGLISH (T1) — France is a small test, not the core.
  • ✅ Revenue per shop — every one of the 547 top digital shops (Revenue & speed tab). Estimate = sales × median price.
  • ✅ Selling speed now — from review dates; exact day-by-day sales from daily snapshots (05:15 UTC, first diff 27 Nov).
  • ✅ What sells — listing winners + sub-niche map with price ladders and formats.
  • ⚠ Buyer COUNTRY is not published by Etsy or EverBee free → buyer LANGUAGE used instead: 89% English, 4% German, 1.5% French (48,676 reviews).
  • ⚠ French budget spreadsheets: only 17 listings and 4 recent reviews among top shops; EverBee: "budget mensuel" 145 searches/mo → tiny but empty. German "budgetplaner" 765/mo vs 93 competing = the better non-English add-on.
  • ⚠ Revenue numbers are estimates (Etsy does not publish revenue). Paid EverBee/eRank would add 30-day sales per listing — not needed to decide.

Skip
  • Printable wall art (3.5M listings; top 10 get only 20 views/day combined)
  • Nursery / kitchen wall art, digital paper (6.8M listings), generic wedding invitations
  • Anything with a brand, character, team or celebrity — one rights-holder report pulls the listing, repeats can close the shop
  • AI sewing/knitting/crochet patterns, recipes, how-to guides, prompt bundles (banned since Oct 2026)

Lifetime revenue ≈ Etsy's lifetime sales count × the shop's median listing price today (EverBee's own "calculated revenue" uses the same formula). "Now" = sales per day from the dates of the shop's last 100 reviews ÷ the shop's review rate (reviews per sale) — an estimate; Etsy does not publish recent sales. Snapshots of every shop's sales count are taken daily from 27 Nov, which will replace this estimate with exact day-by-day sales.

The 5 listings that collected the most of each top shop's last 100 reviews = what is selling right now.

EverBee free plan: estimated monthly Etsy searches ("Volume") and competing listings for each searched keyword; "Family" = the biggest volume among its close variants (EverBee splits the same search across word orders). Score = EverBee's volume ÷ competition rating.

EverBee Product Analytics, top 20 listings by estimated monthly revenue for 17 spreadsheet/wedding/FR/DE searches (the revenue number itself is paid-only; the ranking, price, reviews and views are shown).

What exactly sells inside spreadsheets + wedding — every active listing (first 100 per shop) of the 547 top digital shops, grouped by title; "Recent reviews" = how many of each shop's last 100 reviews landed on those listings (= selling now). Price = USD percentiles.

Competing = active listings Etsy's search matches. Views/day = combined views per day of the top 10 results (lifetime views ÷ listing age). Opportunity = views/day of the top 100 per 1,000 competing listings — higher means more attention per competitor. French keywords only match listings written in French (Etsy shows translated English listings to French buyers too), so their competition is understated — but it shows how few sellers write natively in French.

Sales = Etsy's lifetime transaction count for the shop. Sales/day = lifetime sales ÷ shop age (a young shop with a high number is growing fast). Only shops where at least half the listings are digital.

All active listings of the 60 top digital shops, sorted by views per day. Tags = the shop's own Etsy tags (good keyword ideas).

Etsy AI rules (Oct 2026)
  • AI art and templates are allowed when you play a clear creative role. Label the item "Designed by" and say AI was used in the description.
  • Banned: AI-generated sewing/knitting/crochet/embroidery patterns, recipes, how-to guides and plans; AI prompt bundles; listings made by a bot with no human input.
  • Buyers can flag listings they think are AI-made.
  • From 16 Dec 2026 Etsy's terms let it use seller content for AI development (not for copycats, Etsy says).
  • Keep the word "pattern" out of titles for seamless prints — say "seamless print" / "digital paper".
  • Intellectual property: Etsy removes a listing on any complete rights-holder report without judging it; repeat reports can cost the shop.
Fees on a digital item (Etsy's standard published fees — check Shop Manager for your country)
  • $0.20 listing fee (4 months or until sold; each sale renews it)
  • 6.5% transaction fee on the item price
  • Payment processing ≈ 3% + $0.25 in the US (differs by country)
  • Offsite Ads 12–15% only on sales that come from Etsy's own ads
Calendar
  • Now – mid Dec: 2027 planners, Christmas digital, gift certificates
  • By late Dec: Valentine's designs live
  • Jan – Mar: wedding pack (engagements peak Dec–Feb), budget spreadsheets (New Year money resolutions), tax/bookkeeping
  • France: fête des mères (Mother's Day, late May), rentrée (back to school, late Aug), baptême and mariage season spring–summer
  • All numbers come from Etsy's own API on 26 Nov 2026 — not from eRank/EverBee estimates. Raw files: pull-20261126.json, shops-20261126.json, top-listings-20261126.json.
  • The API gives total sales per shop, not per listing. "Views/day" per listing is the best per-product demand signal Etsy exposes.
  • Prices converted to USD at fixed rates (EUR 1.08, GBP 1.27, CAD 0.72, AUD 0.65).
  • Etsy's website blocked our real-Chrome check through a US proxy ("Access is temporarily restricted"), so Bestseller badges and "sold in past 24 hours" are not in this data.
